mmq.text: Mercadia is a plane whose corrupt Mercadia City is ruled by masks, and in Mercadian Masques the crash-landing of the Weatherlight draws its crew into the local power struggles, with the Cho-Arrim attacking and stealing the ship while city soldiers arrive to arrest the crew.

The magistrate offers Gerrard soldiers and mercenaries to recover the ship, but the Caterans slaughter the Cho-Arrim indiscriminately, and Takara, who turns out to be Volrath in disguise, murders Starke and tries to steal the Weatherlight.
With Ramos's help the crew escapes in the empowered Weatherlight and rams the Recreant, and Cho-Manno declares that the city's masks can no longer hide the truth.
With the Chief Magistrate dead and the Kyren rulers exiled, the peoples form a united government, and Orim, Cho-Manno and Atalla become the new leaders as the crew returns to Dominaria.
